title: Handling Deducted Per Gallon When a Refined Fuels Booking Is Released
content:
A handling deduction is taken per gallon when gallons are released out of a booking on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts, and whose tank stands at the site decides the rate. It is taken only where the site has been served at least twice in the recent quarter.

**Where the tank is the member's own and 2 or more stops were billed on the account in the three months ending on the handling date**, the handling deduction is 0.015 USD per gallon.

**Where the tank is the cooperative's and 2 or more stops were billed in that window**, the handling deduction is 0.03 USD per gallon.

**Where fewer than 2 stops were billed in that window**, nothing is deducted per gallon for handling.

| Whose tank stands at the site | Stops billed in the three months ending on the handling date | Handling deducted per gallon |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The member's own | 2 or more | 0.015 USD |
| The cooperative's | 2 or more | 0.03 USD |
| Either | Fewer than 2 | Nothing |

The cooperative's own tank bears the heavier deduction, since the cooperative carries the plant at the site. The stop test is met at 2 stops exactly, and it is a count of the stops billed on the account rather than of the gallons they took.

*Hypothetical.* An account at a site with a cooperative tank, 3 stops billed in the quarter, has 0.03 USD per gallon deducted: on 1250.0 gallons settled, 37.50 USD. The same account at a site with the member's own tank has 0.015 USD per gallon deducted, coming to 18.75 USD on those gallons. With 1 stop billed in the quarter, nothing is deducted on either tank.
